description: This is a PHP source file defining the DatabaseConfigurationController class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrade process. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages pre-render actions for the database configuration screen.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the database configuration step during the installer upgrade process. It prepares the view component for rendering the database info screen and sets the current screen state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides a method to set up the component for the database info screen and update the current screen state before rendering the view.
